quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Peak Owner EPS normalized to €8.88 adjusted recurring EPS to neutralize extreme non-cash IFRS currency hedge mark-to-market swings (€7.18B IFRS net income vs negative hedge marks in 2022/2024). Operating ROIC capped at 35.0% tangible ceiling neutralizing serial aerospace acquisition intangibles and negative working capital structure. 5-10Y forward compound growth rate of 9.5% supported by LEAP narrowbody fleet flight-hour expansion (4.5%), high-margin aftermarket spare parts pricing (3.5%), defense and aircraft equipment (1.5%), and net buybacks (0.5%), offset by minor supply chain frictions (-0.5%). Pristine balance sheet with €4.7B net cash.
